args: Activate the sleep-consolidate skill: review today's turn journals in local/memory/journal/, apply incremental delta updates to local/MEMORY.md and local/memory/facts.jsonl, stage any skill proposals in local/memory/proposals/, and commit the private local/ Vault git repo.
description: Every night at 11:30 PM (America/Los_Angeles), consolidates the day's turn journals into long-term memory and commits the private Vault.
